evidence: Required empirical app discrimination is absent. The actual frozen workbook Quality Checks!D41 and Internal Quality Checks!D41 require a spread across partial-quality apps. Frozen quality-checks.md:165-167 warns that a single gate or common precondition can collapse the signal; current qc/README.md Runtime evidence and qc/REVIEW_POLICY.md Runtime and model evidence require hash-bound real reward-discrimination measurements, not source reasoning alone. The current raw-evidence-index.json explicitly limits its scope to local observations and says app reward discrimination/ranking is absent; runtime-evidence.json is absent. Static support: task/tests/scoring.toml:1-11 preserves the canonical 0.6 functional/0.2 polish/0.2 visual shares and strict functional floor 0.05. The helper is byte-identical to the frozen template; tests/tools/score.py:46-48 computes the weighted mean and only zeros failed gates/floor. Parsed inventory is 145 binary functional criteria (weight sum45), five binary polish criteria (sum9), and five anchored five-point Likert visual criteria (sum6). Functional ordinary outcomes carry17 and coordinated outcomes28, with distinct credit for displayed arithmetic, actor permissions, record persistence, previews, freshness, settlement and retries. Functional prompt.md:11,13 directs independent scoring, continued testing, equivalent valid fresh setups and preservation of completed observations; polish prompt.md:8,10,14 and visual prompt.md:8,10 do likewise. The outer constraints gate, judge.toml:23-26, limits its prerequisite to basic requisition/offer creation and independent-context saved readback, explicitly excluding approvals and complex economics. Executed python -B qc/runs/hireops-2026-10-01-transaction-hardening-r3/per-row-review/evidence/40/inspect-score.py against the unchanged frozen score.py. Six synthetic dimension-input cases produced rewards0,0,0.22,0.34,0.74,1; observations.json SHA256=2f7d40da547ae8a3787f20b1d69ceca35ce4771e65eb6d46be37d383f9d88e7e. This is score-helper arithmetic only, not six scored apps or any Oracle score. Verified six cited raw-index artifact hashes and all15 tests_sha256 bindings in local/configured-inspection/results.json plus all14 solution bindings in local/partial-budget-recovery/results.json against the frozen source. Configured inspection SHA25668a8e192fc287fa192052ca0c74eccdcda93ba0d28f440641f0ef8337825db57 describes parser/prompt/schema/CLI launch only and NO provider grade. Gate witness results SHA256fd8410bc91102874ef98edfdbacf19f7853687956e076acc684d36c565d9ec75 show basic saved-readback success for golden and deliberately dead approval, and failure for no-op creation; its inspected driver asserts these finite UI observations, not rewards. Partial-budget-recovery results SHA256afd494316961a21106f615048bd30a52faec1ad7977bee69c527a06229be222b and driver SHA256344086e8907d3858082778002f4f12749f3dc99a9857a6df621c612d075279d3 demonstrate that removing economic-history version refusal permits an invalid restored-balance commit while genuine budget-refusal editor recovery still succeeds. This supports distinct observable outcomes but supplies no configured reward. Broken-app attempt considered: an otherwise good app with approval disabled can clear the minimal intake gate, but successful-approval controls prevent it farming downstream refusal/settlement credit; independently observed intake, pending calculations and basic durability may retain credit. An otherwise good app missing ABA freshness can lose hro_change_aba (functional judge.toml:1050 onward) while its genuine editor recovery retains polish credit; the diagnostic fixture exhibits both observations. No full configured score was measured for either. Conforming alternative considered: initially empty operational history, generated IDs and different routes/labels are expressly allowed by instruction.md:5,11 and the gate/prompt wording; the reviewer must create controls, so those differences alone do not justify collapsed reward. No concrete conforming-app false failure is established for this row. Full configured runs across progressively partial apps remain necessary to determine actual spread and any score collapse caused by workload/common setup.
counterexample: No confirmed scoring counterexample. Diagnostic broken alternatives are the dead-approval app and the missing-economic-version app described in the evidence; neither has measured configured rewards. A conforming empty-history/generated-ID/different-route app is allowed by the public brief and judged controls; a false failure has not been observed.
suggested_fix: Obtain authorized full configured judge runs on the frozen golden and multiple controlled partial apps, preserve criterion/dimension rewards and raw trajectories, and add a current-input hash-bound reward_is_graded_not_binary_and_discriminates runtime record. Keep synthetic arithmetic and scripted browser evidence labelled separately; do not change shared gates, floor, scoring policy or timeouts to manufacture a spread.
